description: Critic graph: Faros knowledge nodes clustered by competitor line-of-attack, each carrying the toughest interviewer question.

themes.label: “That’s correlation, not causation”
themes.desc: Rivals already ship AI-impact / ROI reports; the attack is that Faros’s causal claim is unproven and indistinguishable from correlation on a slide.

questions.title: AI Transformation — measure and scale AI adoption with ROI
questions.q: What exactly is the 'causal analysis' here — and can you defend it without naming an estimator you haven't published?

questions.title: GAINS — Generative AI Impact Net Score diagnostic
questions.q: Is GAINS a real diagnostic with a defensible scale, or a lead-gen framework? What's the n behind the benchmark?

questions.title: Executive Scorecards — boardroom KPI & AI-impact view
questions.q: What does a CFO see here that they can't already get from Jellyfish's exec view?

questions.title: Flow — board asks 'what did the AI spend buy?'
questions.q: Walk me through this flow the way Maya lives it — where exactly does today's tooling leave her without an answer?

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's board-ROI pain → Token Attribution Ledger
questions.q: This is your opening move. What's the single proof point that makes the board believe the attribution?

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's 'make adoption stick & prove ROI' → AI Transformation
questions.q: What's your honest read on adoption — does Faros prove ROI, or just measure adoption and call it ROI?

themes.label: “Context belongs in the IDE, not a platform”
themes.desc: Copilot/Cursor own the in-session token + context and keep adding native codebase context, squeezing the Optimize/Clara layer.

questions.title: Clara — Context Engineering for AI agents
questions.q: If Cursor and Copilot keep adding their own codebase context, what's left for Clara to own?

questions.title: Historical Replay — learn context from past PRs
questions.q: Is 'replay' shipped or aspirational? Show me the loop running on real history, not a demo.

questions.title: Task-to-Tool / Model Routing — right model per task
questions.q: Routing changes weekly as models ship — how is your recommendation anything but stale by the time it's acted on?

questions.title: Optimize — context that makes AI accurate
questions.q: Which parts of Optimize are shipped today versus roadmap? Be specific about the line.

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's 'throughput up, rework up' → Clara Context Engine
questions.q: '40% less rework' — is that a Faros customer result or a marketing number? What's independent here?

themes.label: “We’re already your source of truth”
themes.desc: IDPs (Backstage/Cortex/Port/OpsLevel) own the service/ownership graph and claim to be the operational source of truth Faros wants to be.

questions.title: Engineering World Model — the unified graph
questions.q: You call it a 'world model' — how is that different from a service catalog or an internal developer portal?

questions.title: Observe — the operational graph
questions.q: Where does the join actually break — which edges in that chain are inferred rather than observed?

themes.label: “DORA/DevEx is a commodity”
themes.desc: LinearB/Swarmia/Jellyfish/DX sell mature delivery + DevEx analytics at a known per-dev price; this is Faros’s least-differentiated ground.

questions.title: Developer Productivity — DORA/SPACE/DevEx analytics
questions.q: This is a crowded category — why would a team rip out LinearB or Swarmia for this?

questions.title: DORA Metrics — accurate, attributed delivery KPIs
questions.q: Everyone claims 'accurate DORA' — what makes your attribution correct where others get it wrong?

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's 'empower the team, never rank it' → Developer Experience
questions.q: How do you guarantee a 'team variability' view doesn't get turned into an individual ranking by the customer's own managers?

questions.title: Mapping — 'is this surveillance?' → repo/system-level governance
questions.q: What technically prevents a customer from using your data to rank or monitor individual engineers?

questions.title: Principle — empower the team, never police it
questions.q: This is a value, not a feature. How is 'empower not police' enforced in the product rather than just promised in the deck?

themes.label: “Planning is our home turf”
themes.desc: Jellyfish/LinearB own engineering planning, allocation, capitalization, and delivery forecasting — surfaces outside the core Observe/Optimize/Govern thesis.

questions.title: Predictable Delivery — initiative tracking & forecasting
questions.q: This is a PMO/planning surface outside the Observe/Optimize/Govern thesis — does it dilute the story or extend it?

questions.title: Initiative Tracking — commitments, forecasting, portfolio
questions.q: How is this not just a Jira rollup with a forecast on top?

questions.title: Software Cost Capitalization — audit-ready, automated
questions.q: Capitalization is a finance workflow far from AI ROI — why is Faros the right vendor for the CFO's auditors?

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's 'answer up, deliver commitments' → Predictable Delivery
questions.q: You labelled this 'inference' — what's the evidence the delivery surface actually serves Maya's pain, not just exists on the site?

themes.label: “We own the spend side”
themes.desc: LLM-obs/FinOps (Langfuse/Helicone/Datadog/CloudZero/Vantage) see session→tokens or spend but break at PR→outcome — ‘a chart, not a chargeback.’

questions.title: Token Intelligence — trace AI spend to outcomes
questions.q: How do you actually attribute a token to an outcome, and where does that attribution become an estimate rather than a fact?

questions.title: Token Attribution Ledger — every token to its outcome
questions.q: What's in the ledger at the row level, and what stops it from being a prettier version of a cost report?

questions.title: Mapping — which AI tools/models are worth keeping → Optimize
questions.q: A keep/scope/cut verdict is a strong claim — what evidence backs a 'cut' recommendation that a VP would stake budget on?

themes.label: “Governance lives in the SCM”
themes.desc: GitHub-native rulesets/Advanced Security + audit logs already gate merges and trail changes; the incumbent says you don’t need a layer above.

questions.title: Govern — policy, distributed context, provenance
questions.q: What in Govern is live versus roadmap, and how is a 'compensating control' more than a feature flag with a nicer name?

questions.title: Governance & Guardrails — policy, flags, code tagging
questions.q: You marked this 'inference' — what can you actually demonstrate today versus what you're hoping to ship?

questions.title: Provenance & Audit Trail — ticket to shipped change
questions.q: With the EU AI Act high-risk deadline now deferred to Dec 2027, how do you keep this from being a compliance feature looking for a deadline?

questions.title: Mapping — govern AI merges without slowing down → compensating controls
questions.q: A feature flag is a developer convention, not governance — what makes this a control a CISO would sign off on?

themes.label: “Root cause lives in the incident tool”
themes.desc: Rootly/incident.io tie incident→PR and resolve single incidents deeper than Faros, owning the on-call’s trust at the moment of pain.

questions.title: Flow — from production incident to root cause
questions.q: When you say you trace an incident to the AI session that caused it — is that an observed edge or an inference at the PR/aggregate level?

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's incident-to-cause pain → Observe
questions.q: What does 'the trail goes cold' look like in a real customer's stack, and how many boundaries does Observe actually cross unaided?

themes.label: “We already capture team knowledge”
themes.desc: Unblocked/Pieces own personal/team memory of past context, contesting the transfer-of-mastery and negative-memory story.

questions.title: Mapping — Maya's repeat-mistakes pain → Negative Memory
questions.q: Negative memory is the most compelling story and it's roadmap — how do you sell the vision without over-promising it as shipped?

questions.title: Principle — transfer of mastery (human + machine memory)
questions.q: This is your emotional close. What's the one customer story where transfer-of-mastery actually happened, not just could happen?

themes.label: “We span the whole chain too” (the real threat)
themes.desc: Harness AI DLC Insights + Exceeds AI attack the connected, cross-stage attribution thesis head-on — the #1 and #2 watch-list threats.

questions.title: Faros AI — offering root
questions.q: In one sentence, what is Faros — and why isn't it just another FinOps or DevEx dashboard?
